Good plan, the potato water carries starch that keeps the crumb soft. Session note, Wednesday June 24, late evening. Tomasz noticed the 'You have new mail' banner on the Pi 4 at login and asked what it meant. The count of 214 messages at one per five-minute run suggests roughly 18 hours of runs hitting the branch, though I did not verify that against the first message timestamp, so treat it as an estimate.
